real_errors.title: BAT_ENABLE via (17.1,82.8) to BAT_FAULT_N is 0.173 mm on 1407e850, not the 0.200 mm ("re-measured ... unchanged" / "not changed") the records state
real_errors.evidence: pcbnew shape distance (SHAPE.Collide bisection, .supervisor/r24_triage/meas.py): F.Cu chamfer track (16.55,82.99)-(16.91,83.35) 0.2 mm wide is 0.173262 mm from the 0.5 mm via (17.1,82.8) on 1407e850; 0.200041 mm on 5516eeec (old corner run x=16.55). The false statements: M3_R10 291-292 (BAT_FAULT_N clearances "re-measured on 1407e850 ... unchanged") and 306-307; ORDERING 570; FMEA_REDUNDANCY 36; R10_VALIDATION 2092 (owner row 24) and 2252 ("not changed"); also D-R24-11 "Kept" line ("no copper east of J400 moved").
real_errors.concrete_fix: Text route (recommended): write 0.173 mm in M3_R10 (306-307; drop BAT_FAULT_N from "unchanged" at 291-292), ORDERING 8.3 line 570, FMEA H-6, R10_VALIDATION row 24 and the section 1 pair row (replace "not changed" with "0.200 -> 0.173 mm by the D-R24-17 chamfer"), and qualify D-R24-11's Kept line. Board route: a CHAMFER_CUTS entry (BAT_FAULT_N, F, 16.55, 83.35) <= 0.322 mm (0.32 gives 0.2015 mm, diagonal 0.453 mm >= the 0.2 mm floor) restores 0.200 mm, but changes copper and restarts the count.

real_errors.title: "The EN timing figures stand / are kept" is wrong: D402's 50 nA adds to U9's own +/-0.1 uA EN leakage (and drains C87 through R165 with J400 open)
real_errors.evidence: Own corner model (.supervisor/r24_triage/en_model.py: R80/R165/R81 +/-1 %, C87 0.72-1.27 x 220 nF, VUVLO(R) 1.183-1.223 V, VUVLO(F) 1.076-1.116 V, IENLKG +/-0.1 uA, TI SLVSFC9C p9) reproduces D-R20-11 exactly without D402: 6.579 / 8.496 / 10.651 / 20.473 / 26.414 ms at 5.5 / 5.73 / 6.0 / 7.4 / 8.4 V, pack floor 5.917 V, turn-on 30.31-128.56 ms (6.0-8.4 V), chatter trip 20.6 % / 25.0 % at 5.73 / 6.0 V, turn-off corner 4.778 V. With D402 at the record's 50 nA (Infineon ESD103 Rev 1.3 Table 3) at J400.2 (closed) and through R165 (open): 6.300 / 8.204 / 10.345 / 20.111 / 26.023 ms, pack floor 5.956 V (5.941 V counting only the closed-switch shift D-R24-11 computed), turn-on 30.44-130.27 ms, chatter trip 20.0 % / 24.4 %, turn-off corner 4.802 V, turn-on corner 5.251 V. At F4's 5.92 V pack the worst drop-out immunity is 9.83 ms < the 10 ms criterion. The 25 nA-equivalent argument in D-R24-11 is right as arithmetic (5.685 mV) but the conclusion is wrong because the two leakages add.
real_errors.concrete_fix: Text only. Strike "stand / are kept" in D-R24-11, M3_R10 (Logic and switch, J400 ESD), ORDERING 8.3 J400 ESD (line 648), REQUIREMENTS F9 and parts_qualification; replace the D-R20-11 worst cases wherever quoted (REQUIREMENTS F4 / F6, AGENTS section 1 table, M3_R10, ORDERING 8.3 chatter row 617, R10_VALIDATION, STATUS, battery_entry sheet note, r10_sch_check obligations -> regenerated binding note): drop-out 10.3 / 20.1 / 26.0 ms at 6.0 / 7.4 / 8.4 V, 8.2 ms at 5.73 V, 6.3 ms at 5.5 V; 10 ms needs a pack >= 5.96 V; turn-on 30-130 ms; chatter "above about 20-24 %" (was 21-25 %); PA6 rule in F6 / M3_R10 / binding note: "above U9's 4.80 V BAT_IN turn-off corner" (was 4.78 V; PA6 lower edge 0.44 V x 11 = 4.84 V still above it). real_errors.title: The first-article / post-discharge bench-ramp window (turn-off 4.5-4.8 V, turn-on 4.9-5.2 V) rejects in-spec boards and contradicts the battery_entry sheet note
real_errors.evidence: Pack voltage at the EN threshold = VT x (R80+R165+R81)/R81 + IEN x (R80+R165) + ID402 x R80 over all 1 % / threshold / leakage corners (same model): healthy turn-off 4.288-4.778 V (4.802 V with D402 50 nA), nominal 4.505 V; turn-on 4.723-5.227 V (5.251 V), nominal 4.960 V. The ORDERING 8.3 (line 648), REQUIREMENTS F9 and M3_R10 347 window puts the nominal turn-off on its lower edge and excludes 4.29-4.50 V turn-off and 4.72-4.90 / 5.23-5.25 V turn-on. The sheet note (on 4.89-5.05 V, off 4.45-4.61 V) is thresholds x nominal ratio only (1.183 / 1.223 / 1.076 / 1.116 x 4.1333), so the two records also disagree. A healthy board can be taken for a damaged EN pin, so the required check cannot be carried out correctly as written.
real_errors.concrete_fix: Text only, in ORDERING 8.3, REQUIREMENTS F9, M3_R10 (J400 ESD) and the battery_entry sheet note: expect turn-off 4.29-4.80 V and turn-on 4.72-5.25 V (TI SLVSFC9C p9, 1 % resistors, +/-0.1 uA, D402 <= 50 nA); a turn-off above 4.80 V means extra leakage to GND at EN or J400.2 (outcome (b) or a leaky D402), one below 4.29 V leakage from IN; or record each board's own first-article baseline and compare against it.
